messages.content: VG-GENOME-01 is the 16-byte magic identifier at the start of every Vault Genome bundle file. It distinguishes a model bundle from the older vault envelope and lets tools refuse to process the wrong file type before any cryptographic operation runs.
What is the Vault Genome interface contract?

The Vault Genome interface contract is three Go interfaces — Producer, Verifier, Sealer — frozen by an ADR. Producer issues attestation evidence, Verifier validates it, Sealer wraps and unwraps payloads bound to a TEE measurement. All five reference TEE backends implement this same contract.
What does payload SHA-256 prove in a genome bundle?

The payload SHA-256 in a genome envelope proves the integrity of the unsealed bytes. It is bound into the AEAD as additional authenticated data, recorded in the envelope, and re-checked after unsealing — so any divergence is detected before the payload reaches the caller.
